# Week 1 guide

This week you build the smallest useful version of your project: a starter assistant that answers
one fixed question, running where other people can reach it.

1. Create a code repository and add a `README.md` that says what the project is. Give it a section
   headed Setup that explains how to run the assistant.
2. Run the starter assistant on your own computer and check that it answers its one question.
3. Publish it at a web address that anyone can open, without logging in.

Keep notes as you go: what you tried, what failed, and how you fixed it. You will use them in your
reflection at the end of the week.
